verdict.rationale: Numeral is an API-first tax service. It documents headless programmatic use: a TEST API key, REST endpoints for products, calculations and transactions, and an authenticated health-check endpoint that automation could poll. It also ships an HTTPS MCP server that agents call with a secret API key. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI pipeline integration, or a CI-oriented sandbox workflow, and no OpenAPI spec was found by probe. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, CI/test-mode automation guidance, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
